description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the effect of different diffusion steps on text generation quality across three metrics. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Diffusion Step," with discrete numeric values ordered in ascending sequence from left to right: 100, 250, 500, 1000, and 2000. The vertical axis represents the measured metric values, though it lacks an axis label, a numerical scale, and tick marks; instead, the precise value for each bar is visually emphasized by being explicitly annotated directly above it. The chart features grouped bars arranged side-by-side for each diffusion step category. Based on the top-left legend, each group consists of three components: "ROUGE-1" shown as a light blue bar with diagonal hatching, "ROUGE-2" shown as a light green bar with stippled dots, and "ROUGE-L" shown as a light orange bar with cross-hatching. All bars are outlined in black. The annotated data indicates a consistent, positive progression in height for all three metric components as the diffusion step increases. The lowest value in the chart is the ROUGE-2 bar at diffusion step 100, annotated as 0.1, and the tallest bar is the ROUGE-1 bar at diffusion step 2000, annotated as 41.2. At the lowest category of step 100, the ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L values are 6.3 and 3.0, respectively, while at the highest category of step 2000, the corresponding ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L values reach 19.1 and 33.4.
